rawOutputNote: Byte-identical copy of the owner's ~/Downloads/codex-083-t002.json (6241 bytes), unedited.
triageMethod: Orchestrator re-read of every cited line at develop, SPEC-082 REQ-005/REQ-009/REQ-013 and the 083 T001 record; each claim treated as a hypothesis to refute; the zero-variance and floor bounds recomputed by hand (all-pass tie, T = 20: floor SE 0.0391, t(19, 0.95) = 1.729, bound -0.068). Findings that changed how an owner decision works were put to the owner interactively, with worked examples.

triage.evidence: With every task at 0/5 in both arms all paired differences are 0, the clustered error and bootstrap spread are 0, and the lower bound 0 > -0.10 gives noninferior with no information.
triage.action: Owner rule 2026-11-24 ('Informativas + suelo binomial'): REQ-005 uses max(clustered SE, Jeffreys binomial floor); REQ-010 counts only informative tasks (baseline succeeds at least once) toward T >= 20. All-fail is descriptive-only; a 20-task 5/5 tie gets a floor bound of about -0.068 (t on 19 df). SC-005, SC-010, T003, T004 and procedures 005 and 010 updated.

triage.evidence: The bootstrap and lineage checks had no fixed formula, resample count, seed in the seal, lineage estimator, unavailable-check rule or definition of disagreement.
triage.action: REQ-003 seals the sensitivity methods and seed; REQ-005 fixes them (task bootstrap, 10 000 resamples, PCG64, percentile bound; lineage means with t on L-1 df). Owner rule 2026-11-24 ('Cualquier veredicto distinto'): any differing sensitivity verdict, or one that cannot be computed (fewer than 2 lineages), gives inconclusive.

triage.evidence: Same gap as S82-004: gate tasks come only from the private split and need T >= 20, while the first SPEC-082 corpus yields about 4 to 10 private tasks.
triage.action: Aligned with the owner's S82-004 decision: REQ-010 and Risks state that verdicts are deferred and reports descriptive-only until the private split reaches 20 (SPEC-082 REQ-013).

triage.evidence: OD-5 (refresh after 5 uses) had no ledger, counting event, owner or fail-closed rule.
triage.action: REQ-004/SC-004, T009 and procedure_004: append-only use ledger bound to the split manifest hash, kept with the private split; a use counts at seal time whatever the run's end; sealing refuses after 5 uses or a recorded suspected leak until a refreshed split is recorded; the owner records leaks and refreshes.

triage.evidence: OD-6 reports per-task regressions but nothing makes them visible before a move to candidate; one task at 5/5 -> 0/5 with 19 ties gives delta -0.05 and can pass.
triage.action: Owner choice 2026-11-24 ('Resumen obligatorio + tu acuse'): REQ-006/SC-006 add a mandatory per-task regression summary (ids for public tasks, salted commitments for private ones) and require the owner's acknowledgement in the SPEC-085 move record; OD-6 unchanged (it does not block on its own). SPEC-085 must carry the acknowledgement field when its T001 runs. Refined the same day: graded summary with pre-registered confirmation trials (10 more per arm on up to 5 flagged tasks, verdict unchanged) and an acknowledgement bound to the verdict and summary hashes; with 5 trials soft flags appear by chance in 65-98 % of 20-task null comparisons, and 15 trials cut chance persistence to 0.06-2 % per task while confirming a 0.9 to 0.4 drop about 82 % of the time (binomial calculation).

triage.evidence: REQ-008 did not invalidate a task that loses all trials in one arm (5 % arm rate, undefined task rate) and did not define rerun accounting.
triage.action: REQ-008/SC-008 and procedure_008: accounting follows SPEC-082 REQ-009 (registered trial unit); a task with no valid trial in either arm makes the comparison invalid whatever the rates.

triage.evidence: procedure_004 made a 4-trial fixture invalid while SC-010 and procedure_010 made 20 tasks with one at 4 registered trials descriptive-only.
triage.action: REQ-004 and procedures 004 and 010 separate an under-registered design (descriptive-only) from executed trials that differ from the registration (invalid).

triage.evidence: T008 adds a dated line to the SPEC-049 protocol, so the whole-file hash must change, while SC-002 and procedure_002 required it unchanged.
triage.action: SC-002, T008 and procedure_002 check the frozen-section hashes unchanged and record the expected whole-file hash after the added line.
